label: prf:gram-determinant-plancherel-ratio
title: Proof of gram determinant plancherel ratio
html:
Proof. Proof of gram determinant plancherel ratio

Proof. The Gram matrix of the Markov pairing on H_n(R, q) is block-diagonal in the central-idempotent basis with entries

  G^{q}_{\lambda \mu}
  \;=\;
  \delta_{\lambda \mu} \cdot
  \frac{\dim_q V_\lambda \cdot \dim V_\lambda}{[n]_q!}

(Gram-spectral connection). The classical limit q \to 1 replaces \dim_q \to \dim and [n]_q! \to n!. For the 2-knot (\beta_s, \beta_w) configuration, the relevant determinant projects onto the rank-2 sublattice spanned by \beta_s, \beta_w, factoring over the Wedderburn blocks weighted by character coefficients c_\lambda^{(s)} \cdot c_\lambda^{(w)}. Substituting and taking the ratio yields the displayed formula. \square
